families.name: Flexbox layout authoring
families.scope: Author flex declarations for a selected canonical node through a supported source adapter after document and command-journal prerequisites.
families.refusal: Refuse unsupported source ownership, ambiguous selectors, invalid CSS values and stale revisions; retain the current rendered layout.
families.recovery: Undo the exact flex declaration change without resetting sibling properties or unrelated breakpoint rules.
families.feedback: Show main and cross axes, winning declaration, affected elements and breakpoint before confirmation.
families.evidence: Use nested flex, wrapped content, RTL, intrinsic sizing and narrow viewport fixtures; compare declared source diffs and rendered boxes.

capabilities.title: Set flex container display
capabilities.outcome: Convert a selected owned container between block, flex and inline flex while preserving its children and unrelated declarations.

capabilities.title: Choose flex main axis
capabilities.outcome: Switch row and column flow with a canvas axis indicator and a preview of the resulting child order.

capabilities.title: Reverse flex flow direction
capabilities.outcome: Preview row reverse or column reverse while preserving DOM order and explaining the difference between visual and reading order.

capabilities.title: Configure flex wrapping
capabilities.outcome: Choose nowrap, wrap or wrap reverse and show which children move onto additional lines at the active width.

capabilities.title: Set main axis distribution
capabilities.outcome: Apply justify content options with a live distribution diagram that distinguishes available space from explicit margins and gaps.

capabilities.title: Set cross axis alignment
capabilities.outcome: Apply align items to the selected container and identify children whose explicit align self declaration overrides that result.

capabilities.title: Distribute wrapped flex lines
capabilities.outcome: Edit align content only when multiple flex lines exist and explain why the property has no effect otherwise.

capabilities.title: Author independent flex gaps
capabilities.outcome: Set row and column gaps independently and show their physical direction for the current flex direction and writing mode.

capabilities.title: Set flex item growth
capabilities.outcome: Change an item's grow factor while comparing its resulting share against sibling factors at the same container size.

capabilities.title: Set flex item shrinkage
capabilities.outcome: Adjust shrink factors and identify minimum content constraints that prevent the selected item from shrinking as expected.

capabilities.title: Author flex item basis
capabilities.outcome: Set a length, percentage or automatic flex basis and expose the source of the item's starting main size.

capabilities.title: Override individual item alignment
capabilities.outcome: Set align self for one flex item without rewriting the container's shared alignment or the other children's overrides.

capabilities.title: Edit visual flex order
capabilities.outcome: Change an item's order value with a reading order warning and an exact affected sibling preview before saving.

capabilities.title: Explain automatic flex margins
capabilities.outcome: Display which automatic margins absorb free space and allow editing the selected margin without silently changing justify content.

capabilities.title: Compare flex shorthand components
capabilities.outcome: Expand an existing flex shorthand into its interpreted grow, shrink and basis values before proposing an equivalent edit.

capabilities.title: Restore intrinsic flex minimums
capabilities.outcome: Inspect minimum width or height constraints and explicitly reset only the rule preventing the selected item from fitting.

capabilities.title: Preview equal width flex items
capabilities.outcome: Preview a shared equal width recipe and list all affected items before changing their common source declaration.

capabilities.title: Preview media and text flex rows
capabilities.outcome: Show how a fixed media item and flexible text item behave with long content and a narrow container.

capabilities.title: Inspect nested flex constraints
capabilities.outcome: Trace the selected item's size through nested flex ancestors and expose the first constraint responsible for overflow.

capabilities.title: Compare flex layouts across widths
capabilities.outcome: Show synchronized flex overlays at selected widths so operators can verify wrapping and alignment before committing one scoped change.

families.name: CSS Grid layout authoring
families.scope: Author explicit and implicit grid declarations on owned containers and items while keeping named areas and source order reviewable.
families.refusal: Refuse overlapping named area definitions, invalid track syntax, ambiguous shared selectors and unsupported subgrid persistence.
families.recovery: Restore the previous track and placement declarations as one transaction without moving or recreating document children.
families.feedback: Show numbered lines, named areas, implicit tracks and affected items in the existing canvas overlay and inspector.
families.evidence: Exercise repeated tracks, nested grids, sparse and dense placement, RTL, intrinsic content and grid overflow at several widths.

capabilities.title: Create explicit grid columns
capabilities.outcome: Add or remove explicit column tracks with numbered grid lines and a preview that preserves all existing child nodes.

capabilities.title: Create explicit grid rows
capabilities.outcome: Edit explicit row tracks while distinguishing authored rows from additional implicit rows created by the current grid items.

capabilities.title: Edit grid track units
capabilities.outcome: Choose fixed, fractional, percentage or automatic track sizing and show the resulting computed size for each track.

capabilities.title: Author minimum maximum tracks
capabilities.outcome: Edit minmax track constraints with validation for invalid minimums and a preview of their effect on intrinsic content.

capabilities.title: Configure repeated grid tracks
capabilities.outcome: Author repeat counts through structured controls and preserve equivalent supported source syntax when saving the selected container's rule.

capabilities.title: Preview automatic fill tracks
capabilities.outcome: Compare auto fill behavior at the active width and identify empty reserved tracks rather than presenting them as actual children.

capabilities.title: Preview automatic fit tracks
capabilities.outcome: Compare auto fit collapsing behavior with the same content and width so operators can choose an intentional responsive layout.

capabilities.title: Name grid template areas
capabilities.outcome: Create named area cells and reject disconnected or nonrectangular area shapes before the declaration reaches the command journal.

capabilities.title: Place items by named area
capabilities.outcome: Assign a selected grid item to an existing named area and identify other items that currently occupy that area.

capabilities.title: Place items by grid lines
capabilities.outcome: Edit start and end lines independently with visible line numbers and a preview of the resulting occupied cells.

capabilities.title: Set grid item spans
capabilities.outcome: Set a row or column span for one item while preserving its opposite axis placement and explicit source order.

capabilities.title: Author implicit track sizes
capabilities.outcome: Set grid auto rows or columns and clearly mark the tracks whose size comes from those implicit declarations.

capabilities.title: Choose grid auto flow
capabilities.outcome: Switch row or column placement and show which unpositioned children move while preserving their document identities and DOM order.

capabilities.title: Preview dense grid packing
capabilities.outcome: Preview dense placement separately and explain any visual sequence that differs from keyboard traversal or document reading order.

capabilities.title: Set grid container alignment
capabilities.outcome: Edit justify and align content with track size feedback that distinguishes grid distribution from individual item alignment.

capabilities.title: Set grid item alignment
capabilities.outcome: Edit justify self and align self for one item without changing sibling placement or container level alignment defaults.

capabilities.title: Author independent grid gaps
capabilities.outcome: Set row and column gaps with line overlays that distinguish gaps from track sizes and item margins.

capabilities.title: Inspect subgrid inheritance
capabilities.outcome: Display inherited subgrid tracks and their owning parent declaration; unsupported source adapters leave the subgrid inspection read only.

capabilities.title: Resize grid tracks from canvas
capabilities.outcome: Drag an authored grid boundary to preview a track change and require a reviewable declaration diff before persistence.

capabilities.title: Compare named area breakpoint changes
capabilities.outcome: Compare area maps across breakpoints and expose items that become unassigned or overlap when a narrower template takes effect.

families.name: Box model and intrinsic sizing
families.scope: Inspect and author dimensions, margins, padding and intrinsic constraints for selected owned nodes without replacing unrelated shorthand declarations.
families.refusal: Refuse invalid dimensional expressions, unsupported unit conversions and edits that cannot identify a single intended source declaration.
families.recovery: Undo one box model transaction while retaining neighboring declarations, source comments and other breakpoint overrides.
families.feedback: Show physical and logical edges, computed sizes, constraint sources and the proposed source diff before saving.
families.evidence: Compare content box and border box elements, long intrinsic content, mixed units, aspect ratios and vertical writing modes.

capabilities.title: Inspect the computed box model
capabilities.outcome: Display content, padding, border and margin dimensions from the rendered element alongside the declarations that contribute to those measurements.

capabilities.title: Edit linked padding edges
capabilities.outcome: Apply one padding value to explicitly linked edges while allowing an operator to unlink individual edges before making the change.

capabilities.title: Edit independent margin edges
capabilities.outcome: Change one margin edge without rewriting the remaining margins or replacing an unrelated authored margin shorthand in the source.

capabilities.title: Author logical padding properties
capabilities.outcome: Edit block and inline padding with a writing mode preview that shows the corresponding physical edges for the selection.

capabilities.title: Author logical margin properties
capabilities.outcome: Edit block and inline margins and explain their physical positions when text direction or writing mode changes across previews.

capabilities.title: Set preferred element width
capabilities.outcome: Author width using supported units and display the difference between the preferred value and the final constrained rendered width.

capabilities.title: Set preferred element height
capabilities.outcome: Author height with a preview that exposes content clipping or expansion rather than silently hiding overflow created by the change.

capabilities.title: Set minimum size constraints
capabilities.outcome: Edit minimum width and height independently and identify which minimum currently prevents the selected element from fitting its parent.

capabilities.title: Set maximum size constraints
capabilities.outcome: Edit maximum width and height with a canvas indicator that distinguishes capped elements from elements sized by their contents.

capabilities.title: Choose box sizing behavior
capabilities.outcome: Compare content box and border box behavior with the same dimensions and show the resulting outer size before applying a change.

capabilities.title: Author aspect ratio constraints
capabilities.outcome: Set a supported aspect ratio and explain which definite dimension or intrinsic media size determines the resulting opposite dimension.

capabilities.title: Inspect intrinsic content sizes
capabilities.outcome: Compare min content, max content and available width for the selected element without persisting temporary measurement styles into application source.

capabilities.title: Author fit content sizing
capabilities.outcome: Set supported fit content sizing and preview the limits imposed by the available container size and the selected element's contents.

capabilities.title: Preview percentage size references
capabilities.outcome: Identify the containing block used for percentage dimensions and show when an indefinite ancestor prevents the expected percentage height.

capabilities.title: Compare relative dimension units
capabilities.outcome: Preview em, rem, viewport and container relative dimensions with their actual reference sizes before converting an authored supported value.

capabilities.title: Preserve automatic dimensional values
capabilities.outcome: Expose automatic values as intentional constraints and prevent a measurement readout from replacing authored auto values with fixed pixels.

capabilities.title: Inspect collapsed block margins
capabilities.outcome: Show which adjacent block margins collapse and distinguish their resulting spacing from the sum of the individually authored margins.

capabilities.title: Author bounded fluid dimensions
capabilities.outcome: Preview a supported clamp expression with its minimum, preferred and maximum values across a selected range of viewport widths.

capabilities.title: Explain replaced element sizing
capabilities.outcome: Show intrinsic size and aspect ratio contributions for images and other replaced elements before changing their explicit size constraints.

capabilities.title: Audit horizontal sizing overflow
capabilities.outcome: Identify elements whose outer box exceeds the selected container and trace the contributing width, margin or intrinsic minimum declaration.

families.name: Positioning overflow and stacking
families.scope: Inspect containing blocks, scroll containers and stacking contexts; persist supported position and overflow declarations through bounded commands.
families.refusal: Refuse unsupported containing-block rewrites, ambiguous stacking edits and changes that hide required controls without an explicit operator decision.
families.recovery: Restore previous positioning and scroll constraints without resetting application scroll state or unrelated style rules.
families.feedback: Show the containing block, sticky limits, scroll ownership and stacking context instead of treating z-index as a global depth number.
families.evidence: Use nested scroll containers, sticky headers, transformed ancestors, dialogs, clipping and competing stacking contexts at several viewport sizes.

capabilities.title: Choose positioning mode
capabilities.outcome: Preview static, relative, absolute, fixed and sticky positioning while showing the selected element's resulting containing block and normal flow participation.

capabilities.title: Edit physical position offsets
capabilities.outcome: Set top, right, bottom and left offsets independently and expose which offsets currently control the selected element's rendered position.

capabilities.title: Edit logical inset properties
capabilities.outcome: Author inset block and inline offsets with direction aware canvas guides that identify their physical edges for the current writing mode.

capabilities.title: Inspect absolute containing blocks
capabilities.outcome: Trace the ancestor establishing an absolutely positioned element's containing block and identify the declaration responsible for that relationship.

capabilities.title: Inspect fixed containing blocks
capabilities.outcome: Identify transformed or otherwise qualifying ancestors that contain a fixed element so viewport attachment is not incorrectly assumed in the inspector.

capabilities.title: Preview sticky positioning bounds
capabilities.outcome: Display a sticky element's scroll container, threshold and containing block limits while scrolling the owned preview through its active range.

capabilities.title: Author axis specific overflow
capabilities.outcome: Edit horizontal and vertical overflow independently and explain any computed value interaction that changes the other axis's behavior.

capabilities.title: Inspect clipping ancestors
capabilities.outcome: List the ancestors clipping the selected rendered box and reveal their overflow or clipping declarations without changing application visibility.

capabilities.title: Author overflow clipping margins
capabilities.outcome: Set a supported overflow clip margin with a visible boundary preview and preserve the element's existing clipping mode and other dimensions.

capabilities.title: Inspect stacking context ancestry
capabilities.outcome: Show the selected element's stacking context chain and the declarations creating each boundary before exposing a z-index edit control.

capabilities.title: Compare competing stacking contexts
capabilities.outcome: Compare two visible elements through their nearest competing contexts and explain why a larger child z-index cannot cross an ancestor boundary.

capabilities.title: Edit local stacking order
capabilities.outcome: Set z-index within the selected stacking context and list the elements whose relative paint order can change at that level.

capabilities.title: Inspect scroll container ownership
capabilities.outcome: Identify which ancestor owns scrolling for the selected content and distinguish programmatic scrolling from overflow that actually creates a scroll container.

capabilities.title: Author scroll padding edges
capabilities.outcome: Set scroll padding on the owning container with a preview of the target alignment area used by navigation and snapping.

capabilities.title: Author scroll margin edges
capabilities.outcome: Set scroll margins for one target and preview its alignment against sticky headers without modifying neighboring targets or page navigation behavior.

capabilities.title: Configure overscroll behavior
capabilities.outcome: Preview supported overscroll containment independently on each axis and describe the resulting scroll chaining behavior in the local preview.

capabilities.title: Inspect scrollbar layout effects
capabilities.outcome: Compare available content width with scrollbar gutters and identify layout shifts caused by conditional scrollbars in the selected container.

capabilities.title: Author scrollbar gutter policy
capabilities.outcome: Set supported scrollbar gutter values and preview reserved space without treating the operator's operating system scrollbar appearance as portable styling.

capabilities.title: Preview isolated paint contexts
capabilities.outcome: Inspect isolation and containment properties affecting paint order and preview a supported isolation change without rewriting unrelated positioning declarations.

capabilities.title: Audit inaccessible overflow regions
capabilities.outcome: Find clipped focusable controls and content regions lacking usable scrolling, then show the precise clipping or sizing rule responsible for each issue.

families.name: Selectors cascade and style provenance
families.scope: Explain winning CSS declarations and scope supported edits to explicit selectors, layers, states and source locations.
families.refusal: Refuse selector edits with unresolved ownership, unsupported syntax, ambiguous source spans or an unreviewed increase in affected elements.
families.recovery: Restore exact selector and declaration transactions with prior ordering, comments and neighboring rules preserved.
families.feedback: Show specificity, layer, inheritance, importance, source location and affected element counts for every inspected supported property.
families.evidence: Use layered stylesheets, inline declarations, repeated classes, inherited values, pseudo states and conflicting important rules with independently known winners.

capabilities.title: Trace a winning property declaration
capabilities.outcome: Show the winning declaration for a selected computed property with its selector, stylesheet location, active condition and inherited origin where applicable.

capabilities.title: Compare competing declarations
capabilities.outcome: List the matched declarations for one property in cascade order and explain why each losing declaration does not determine the rendered result.

capabilities.title: Display selector specificity components
capabilities.outcome: Present specificity as separate components and compare matching selectors without implying that specificity alone determines the complete cascade order.

capabilities.title: Inspect cascade layer ordering
capabilities.outcome: Show declared layer order and explain how layered and unlayered declarations compete for the selected property at the active state.

capabilities.title: Explain inherited property origins
capabilities.outcome: Trace inherited values through ancestors and identify the source declaration that first supplies the selected element's effective inherited value.

capabilities.title: Distinguish initial and unset values
capabilities.outcome: Preview initial, inherit, unset, revert and revert layer values separately with an explanation of the resulting winning value and its source.

capabilities.title: Inspect custom property resolution
capabilities.outcome: Trace a custom property's references and fallback chain to the resolved value while exposing missing references and cycles without rewriting source.

capabilities.title: Count selector matched elements
capabilities.outcome: Report the current rendered elements affected by a supported selector and identify the inspection scope before a shared rule change is proposed.

capabilities.title: Preview a shared selector edit
capabilities.outcome: Show before and after renderings for all inspected matched elements and require explicit confirmation of the shared edit scope before persistence.

capabilities.title: Create an owned utility class
capabilities.outcome: Create a new class in an explicitly owned stylesheet and attach it only to the selected supported node through one reviewed transaction.

capabilities.title: Rename a class with reference review
capabilities.outcome: Preview all supported source references for a class rename and refuse the operation when references outside the inspected source ownership remain unresolved.

capabilities.title: Inspect compound selector matches
capabilities.outcome: Explain which parts of a supported compound selector match the selected element and identify the conditions preventing a related element from matching.

capabilities.title: Inspect combinator relationship matches
capabilities.outcome: Visualize supported descendant, child and sibling selector relationships using the actual selected document nodes without changing their hierarchy or classes.

capabilities.title: Author state scoped declarations
capabilities.outcome: Edit an explicitly supported state rule separately from its base selector and show the inherited fallback when that state is inactive.

capabilities.title: Inspect pseudo element declarations
capabilities.outcome: Display supported before and after pseudo element styles with their originating rule while clearly distinguishing generated boxes from editable document nodes.

capabilities.title: Review importance changes
capabilities.outcome: Preview the affected declarations and elements before adding or removing important, with a clear explanation of the resulting cascade winner.

capabilities.title: Preserve declaration order intentionally
capabilities.outcome: Show duplicate declarations and their effective order, then update only the selected supported occurrence without silently deduplicating compatibility fallbacks.

capabilities.title: Explain stylesheet origin boundaries
capabilities.outcome: Distinguish application, imported component, browser and unsupported stylesheet origins and expose write controls only for explicitly supported owned sources.

capabilities.title: Inspect inline style ownership
capabilities.outcome: Show whether an inline value comes from authored markup, supported component props or runtime behavior before offering a safe persistence path.

capabilities.title: Preview cascade changes across states
capabilities.outcome: Compare the same property across selected states and widths so an edit's effect on base rules and active overrides is visible before saving.

families.name: Viewport breakpoint authoring
families.scope: Author ordered viewport media conditions and property overrides while preserving explicit base styles and supported source rule ownership.
families.refusal: Refuse overlapping condition rewrites with unresolved precedence, invalid ranges or edits that silently affect unselected breakpoint branches.
families.recovery: Undo breakpoint edits as scoped transactions and restore previous condition ordering without dropping narrower or wider overrides.
families.feedback: Show active conditions, inherited values, override indicators and exact interval boundaries in the existing responsive canvas controls.
families.evidence: Exercise boundary widths, orientation, mixed min and max conditions, landscape devices and multiple independent property override chains.

capabilities.title: Inspect active viewport conditions
capabilities.outcome: List the media conditions currently matching the preview and map each supported condition to the property declarations it activates for the selected node.

capabilities.title: Create a minimum width breakpoint
capabilities.outcome: Add a supported minimum width condition with an explicit insertion position and preview which existing declarations remain inherited beneath that threshold.

capabilities.title: Create a maximum width breakpoint
capabilities.outcome: Add a supported maximum width condition and show the exact inclusive boundary and any neighboring condition that can also match there.

capabilities.title: Create a bounded width interval
capabilities.outcome: Author a supported width range and preview its two boundaries without silently converting neighboring media conditions or altering their cascade order.

capabilities.title: Rename an editor breakpoint label
capabilities.outcome: Change a nonsecret editor label while preserving the underlying CSS condition, source order and references used by existing property overrides.

capabilities.title: Review breakpoint boundary changes
capabilities.outcome: Preview every affected rule and viewport interval before changing a breakpoint's threshold, including overlaps with conditions that remain unchanged.

capabilities.title: Author breakpoint specific property overrides
capabilities.outcome: Set a property inside one selected condition and show the base or ancestor condition from which its previous value was inherited.

capabilities.title: Reset one breakpoint override
capabilities.outcome: Remove only the selected property's declaration from one supported condition and reveal the newly effective inherited or base value in the preview.

capabilities.title: Compare adjacent breakpoint inheritance
capabilities.outcome: Display a property immediately on both sides of a threshold and identify the declaration responsible for the change between the two previews.

capabilities.title: Preview exact breakpoint boundary pixels
capabilities.outcome: Open synchronized previews at the threshold and neighboring pixel widths so inclusive conditions and one pixel gaps can be verified directly.

capabilities.title: Author orientation conditions
capabilities.outcome: Create or edit supported portrait and landscape media conditions independently from width presets and explain when both condition groups are simultaneously active.

capabilities.title: Inspect viewport height conditions
capabilities.outcome: Show active height conditions and allow a supported override to be previewed against short and tall viewport configurations without replacing width rules.

capabilities.title: Preview aspect ratio conditions
capabilities.outcome: Preview supported viewport aspect ratio conditions with their actual evaluated ratio and identify any combined width or orientation constraints that also apply.

capabilities.title: Compare screen and print rules
capabilities.outcome: Switch a read only media preview between screen and print conditions while keeping publication settings and physical printer behavior outside the local preview claim.

capabilities.title: Inspect preference media conditions
capabilities.outcome: Identify active preference conditions such as reduced motion or contrast and keep their overrides separate from the viewport width breakpoint hierarchy.

capabilities.title: Duplicate a breakpoint rule selectively
capabilities.outcome: Copy explicitly selected supported declarations into another condition and show collisions without copying unrelated selectors or overwriting existing target declarations silently.

capabilities.title: Audit empty breakpoint rules
capabilities.outcome: Identify supported media blocks with no effective declarations and preview a source cleanup that preserves comments and unrelated condition branches.

capabilities.title: Audit contradictory viewport conditions
capabilities.outcome: Report conditions that cannot match or produce uncovered intended intervals, with a concrete explanation based on their parsed bounds and conjunctions.

capabilities.title: Compare a responsive layout matrix
capabilities.outcome: Display selected routes at a bounded set of widths and conditions with consistent selection so operators can compare the same element's behavior.

capabilities.title: Export breakpoint definitions as metadata
capabilities.outcome: Export supported condition definitions and editor labels with source references, clearly separating this design inventory from a deployable stylesheet or production release.

families.name: Container queries and adaptive components
families.scope: Inspect container eligibility and author supported size and style query rules for explicitly owned components and their query containers.
families.refusal: Refuse unsupported container syntax, unresolved named container references and edits that would introduce an unreviewed containment boundary.
families.recovery: Restore previous query conditions and containment declarations without changing component children, shared definitions or unrelated viewport rules.
families.feedback: Show the selected query container, evaluated dimensions, condition matches and fallback declarations alongside the component preview.
families.evidence: Use named and anonymous containers, nested containment, inline size limits, writing modes and components displayed in differently sized hosts.

capabilities.title: Inspect the selected query container
capabilities.outcome: Identify the eligible ancestor used by a supported container query and display its measured query dimensions without assuming it is the nearest parent.

capabilities.title: Declare inline size containment
capabilities.outcome: Preview container type inline size on an owned container and explain its intrinsic sizing effects before the source declaration is persisted.

capabilities.title: Declare size containment
capabilities.outcome: Preview full size query containment with explicit feedback about dimensions and intrinsic layout contributions that can change for the selected container.

capabilities.title: Name an owned query container
capabilities.outcome: Assign or edit a supported container name and list query rules whose named container lookup can be affected by that change.

capabilities.title: Create an inline size query
capabilities.outcome: Author a supported inline size condition and show the matched container, threshold and affected component declarations in a bounded local preview.

capabilities.title: Create a block size query
capabilities.outcome: Author a supported block size condition only when the chosen container is eligible and explain why an ineligible container cannot evaluate the rule.

capabilities.title: Create a bounded container range
capabilities.outcome: Edit lower and upper size bounds as a structured condition and preview exact boundary behavior without altering adjacent query rules or source order.

capabilities.title: Inspect nested container selection
capabilities.outcome: Trace eligible nested containers and explain which named or anonymous ancestor is selected for each supported query affecting the current component.

capabilities.title: Preview components in multiple host widths
capabilities.outcome: Render the same component instance in several local host widths while preserving viewport dimensions so container driven changes are distinguishable from viewport breakpoints.

capabilities.title: Compare viewport and container overrides
capabilities.outcome: Show when viewport and container conditions both match and explain the resulting winning declaration using the actual cascade order for the selected property.

capabilities.title: Author container relative lengths
capabilities.outcome: Preview supported container query units with the actual eligible reference dimensions and identify the fallback reference when no qualifying container is available.

capabilities.title: Inspect container query fallback rules
capabilities.outcome: Show the base declarations used when a container condition does not match and keep those fallbacks visible while editing the conditional override.

capabilities.title: Rename named container references safely
capabilities.outcome: Preview all supported declarations and query references for a container rename and refuse persistence when any required reference remains outside owned source.

capabilities.title: Inspect supported style queries
capabilities.outcome: Display the condition and matched custom property for a supported style query, leaving unsupported expressions read only with their original source retained.

capabilities.title: Author supported custom property queries
capabilities.outcome: Create a supported custom property query through structured controls and show the queried container value independently from the descendant's computed value.

capabilities.title: Audit ineffective containment declarations
capabilities.outcome: Report containment that cannot support the associated query and show the exact missing eligibility condition instead of silently adding layout altering declarations.

capabilities.title: Audit unresolved named queries
capabilities.outcome: List supported query rules whose named container cannot be found for an inspected element and reveal the affected ancestor search path.

capabilities.title: Preview adaptive navigation components
capabilities.outcome: Show an owned navigation component at constrained host widths and verify that its container driven arrangement preserves usable controls and reading order.

capabilities.title: Preview adaptive content cards
capabilities.outcome: Compare the same card data in wide and narrow hosts with stable instance identity and identify the query declaration causing each layout transition.

capabilities.title: Export container query inventory
capabilities.outcome: Export supported containers, query conditions and source references as a bounded design inventory without claiming unsupported syntax or generating production CSS implicitly.

families.name: Typography and font shaping
families.scope: Inspect and author supported typography declarations using local font inventories, explicit fallback behavior and source owned style rules.
families.refusal: Refuse unavailable font substitutions, unsupported axis values and source edits that would silently load external font resources or overwrite shared text.
families.recovery: Restore typography declarations and selected font previews without replacing the text content or unrelated language and accessibility preferences.
families.feedback: Show actual loaded faces, fallback use, measured line boxes, writing mode and the source of each effective typography value.
families.evidence: Use long titles, multilingual text, variable fonts, missing glyphs, text zoom and constrained content widths with local fixture fonts.

capabilities.title: Inspect rendered font fallback
capabilities.outcome: Identify the declared font stack and available loaded faces, distinguishing missing fonts from actual glyph fallback without claiming unsupported per glyph certainty.

capabilities.title: Preview a local font family
capabilities.outcome: Preview an installed or checked in font on the selected text while keeping the temporary choice separate from a confirmed source declaration change.

capabilities.title: Author font weight values
capabilities.outcome: Set supported static or variable font weight values and show when the chosen face lacks the requested weight and browser synthesis may occur.

capabilities.title: Author font style and angle
capabilities.outcome: Preview normal, italic and supported oblique angles with the actual available font face rather than silently substituting an unrelated family.

capabilities.title: Author font stretch values
capabilities.outcome: Set a supported font stretch value and show whether the selected font provides an appropriate width face or variable width axis.

capabilities.title: Edit variable font axes
capabilities.outcome: Expose declared variable axes with their supported ranges and preview a bounded axis change without inventing unavailable font capabilities or modifying other axes.

capabilities.title: Configure font optical sizing
capabilities.outcome: Preview automatic or disabled optical sizing and show any available optical size axis contribution separately from the authored text size.

capabilities.title: Author font feature settings
capabilities.outcome: Edit a supported set of typographic feature tags and show the resulting local text specimen without changing its underlying character data.

capabilities.title: Author font kerning behavior
capabilities.outcome: Compare automatic, normal and disabled kerning using the selected local face and preserve the distinction between kerning and authored letter spacing.

capabilities.title: Author fluid font sizes
capabilities.outcome: Preview a supported clamp based font size across chosen widths and show its minimum, preferred and maximum values with the active root size.

capabilities.title: Inspect line height measurements
capabilities.outcome: Display authored line height, computed value and measured line boxes so unitless inheritance is distinguishable from fixed length or percentage declarations.

capabilities.title: Author letter and word spacing
capabilities.outcome: Edit letter spacing and word spacing independently with wrapping feedback and no silent alteration of the selected text content or accessibility preferences.

capabilities.title: Configure text wrapping strategy
capabilities.outcome: Preview supported text wrap modes and show how balanced headings or preserved whitespace affect line breaks at the selected content width.

capabilities.title: Author hyphenation behavior
capabilities.outcome: Configure supported hyphenation settings with the element's language context visible and distinguish automatic browser opportunities from authored soft hyphens.

capabilities.title: Inspect text decoration composition
capabilities.outcome: Show decoration line, style, color, thickness and offset independently and preserve inherited decorations when editing one supported declaration.

capabilities.title: Author text underline geometry
capabilities.outcome: Preview underline offset, thickness and skip ink behavior using actual local glyphs without changing semantic links or the text's interaction target.

capabilities.title: Author vertical text alignment
capabilities.outcome: Inspect and edit supported inline alignment behavior while showing the relevant line box, baseline and neighboring inline content in the canvas.

capabilities.title: Preview writing mode typography
capabilities.outcome: Compare supported horizontal and vertical writing modes with explicit block and inline axes so glyph orientation and line progression remain understandable.

capabilities.title: Inspect text overflow truncation
capabilities.outcome: Show the sizing, overflow and whitespace conditions behind ellipsis or clipping, and keep the full accessible text distinguishable from its rendered truncation.

capabilities.title: Export typography specimen sheets
capabilities.outcome: Generate a local specimen inventory for supported text styles with source references, fallback status and sample widths without publishing fonts or changing application content.

families.name: Color themes gradients and contrast
families.scope: Inspect and author supported color declarations and gradients with explicit color spaces, compositing context and local theme previews.
families.refusal: Refuse invalid color expressions, unresolved token ownership and changes that silently modify all theme modes or remove visible focus indication.
families.recovery: Restore exact color and gradient declarations, preserving stops, interpolation spaces and unrelated theme assignments.
families.feedback: Show computed colors, source tokens, composited backgrounds and any limits affecting contrast calculations or gamut previews.
families.evidence: Use opaque and translucent surfaces, nested backgrounds, wide gamut values, gradients, light and dark themes and disabled controls.

capabilities.title: Inspect computed color provenance
capabilities.outcome: Show the selected property's authored color expression, resolved value and source token or declaration without replacing the original expression with a normalized string.

capabilities.title: Author supported color spaces
capabilities.outcome: Edit supported RGB, HSL, Lab, LCH and OKLCH values with explicit space labels and preview conversions without silently changing the authored color model.

capabilities.title: Preview gamut clipping effects
capabilities.outcome: Indicate when a supported color lies outside the selected preview gamut and distinguish the authored value from the displayed approximation in the inspector.

capabilities.title: Edit color alpha independently
capabilities.outcome: Change opacity in a supported color expression without altering the element's overall opacity or the alpha values of other properties and descendants.

capabilities.title: Inspect composited surface colors
capabilities.outcome: Trace translucent foreground and background layers relevant to the selected text and explain uncertainty when imagery or blending prevents a single reliable background value.

capabilities.title: Create linear gradient backgrounds
capabilities.outcome: Author a supported linear gradient with ordered stops and angle controls while preserving unrelated background layers and the selected node's content.

capabilities.title: Create radial gradient backgrounds
capabilities.outcome: Author supported radial gradient size, shape and position with a local preview that keeps its stops separate from neighboring background image layers.

capabilities.title: Create conic gradient backgrounds
capabilities.outcome: Author a supported conic gradient with explicit origin and stop positions while exposing its source declaration and preserving the other background properties.

capabilities.title: Edit gradient stop positions
capabilities.outcome: Move or insert a supported gradient stop with exact position readouts and a preview that preserves the intended stop order and interpolation behavior.

capabilities.title: Choose gradient interpolation space
capabilities.outcome: Preview supported interpolation spaces and hue methods explicitly so a source edit does not silently change the gradient's authored color behavior.

capabilities.title: Inspect current color inheritance
capabilities.outcome: Trace currentColor to its effective color declaration and preview how changing that source can affect borders, icons and text sharing the same value.

capabilities.title: Preview light and dark theme modes
capabilities.outcome: Switch local theme previews without writing user preferences or publishing settings and show the declarations or tokens responsible for the resulting differences.

capabilities.title: Assign theme scoped color values
capabilities.outcome: Set a color value in one explicitly selected theme scope and display the unchanged values for the other theme modes before confirmation.

capabilities.title: Inspect forced color behavior
capabilities.outcome: Preview supported forced color media behavior and identify controls whose current declarations can suppress expected system color adaptation or visible focus feedback.

capabilities.title: Author accent color declarations
capabilities.outcome: Preview a supported accent color on relevant native controls and disclose browser appearance differences rather than claiming identical cross platform control styling.

capabilities.title: Compare foreground background contrast
capabilities.outcome: Calculate contrast for supported solid foreground and background combinations and show the measured colors, text size assumptions and any compositing limitations.

capabilities.title: Audit contrast across component states
capabilities.outcome: Compare supported default, hover, focus, selected and disabled state color pairs while clearly separating informative findings from complete accessibility certification.

capabilities.title: Inspect blend mode dependencies
capabilities.outcome: Show the backgrounds and stacking boundaries relevant to a selected blend mode and preview changes without treating the composited result as a stable authored color.

capabilities.title: Compare color theme diffs
capabilities.outcome: Display the supported token and declaration changes between two local theme snapshots with unchanged values and unresolved references clearly distinguished.

capabilities.title: Export a source linked color inventory
capabilities.outcome: Export supported colors, gradients and theme assignments with source references and usage counts without collecting rendered user text or publishing any design assets.

families.name: Design tokens and variable collections
families.scope: Author typed design token collections, aliases and mode values using a canonical token registry and supported source ownership mappings.
families.refusal: Refuse alias cycles, incompatible token types, unresolved write ownership and deletion that would leave unreviewed references in owned source.
families.recovery: Undo token transactions with prior collection membership, aliases and mode values preserved; retain unrelated tokens and their source references.
families.feedback: Show token type, resolved mode value, alias path and affected usages before applying changes to shared design values.
families.evidence: Use multi collection aliases, missing references, mode switching, unit values and token migrations with independently verified reference graphs.

capabilities.title: Create typed token collections
capabilities.outcome: Create a named owned collection with explicit token types and source mapping while preserving existing collections and avoiding duplicate canonical collection identifiers.

capabilities.title: Create color design tokens
capabilities.outcome: Add a typed color token with a valid initial value and show the local declarations that can reference it through supported adapters.

capabilities.title: Create dimensional design tokens
capabilities.outcome: Add a length or spacing token with explicit supported units and prevent it from being assigned to incompatible property types silently.

capabilities.title: Create numeric design tokens
capabilities.outcome: Add a number token with declared constraints and display its intended usage domains so raw numbers are not automatically interpreted as pixel dimensions.

capabilities.title: Create text design tokens
capabilities.outcome: Add a supported text token with a bounded value and keep it distinct from user content, localization records and arbitrary executable source expressions.

capabilities.title: Create typography token groups
capabilities.outcome: Group supported font, size, weight and line height tokens with explicit references while preserving the independent identity of each underlying typed value.

capabilities.title: Create token aliases
capabilities.outcome: Reference a compatible token through an explicit alias and show the resolved value and complete alias path before the reference is saved.

capabilities.title: Detect token reference cycles
capabilities.outcome: Identify the concrete alias cycle and its participating token identifiers before accepting a change, leaving all existing resolved values and source files untouched.

capabilities.title: Inspect token dependency graphs
capabilities.outcome: Display a bounded reference graph for one token with incoming usages and outgoing aliases, including any missing or unsupported references in the inspected scope.

capabilities.title: Create explicit token modes
capabilities.outcome: Add a named mode to an owned collection and require an intentional value or supported fallback for each affected token before activation.

capabilities.title: Edit one token mode value
capabilities.outcome: Change a token's value in one selected mode while displaying the untouched values and fallbacks for every other defined mode.

capabilities.title: Assign component token modes
capabilities.outcome: Assign a supported mode override to one component scope and explain its inheritance without changing the project's default mode or unrelated component instances.

capabilities.title: Rename tokens with reference previews
capabilities.outcome: Preview supported reference updates for a token rename and refuse persistence when owned references cannot be rewritten without ambiguity or unrelated diffs.

capabilities.title: Move tokens between owned collections
capabilities.outcome: Preview identifier, alias and usage effects when moving a token, retaining its supported references and rejecting collection type or mode incompatibilities.

capabilities.title: Review token deletion consequences
capabilities.outcome: List owned usages and dependent aliases before deleting a token and require explicit replacements or a refused operation for unresolved live references.

capabilities.title: Bind supported properties to tokens
capabilities.outcome: Replace an explicitly selected literal declaration with a compatible token reference while showing the resulting computed value and all source changes.

capabilities.title: Detach a property from a token
capabilities.outcome: Replace one supported token reference with its intentionally selected resolved value without modifying the shared token or other declarations that still reference it.

capabilities.title: Compare token collection revisions
capabilities.outcome: Show added, changed, removed and unresolved tokens between two collection revisions with mode and alias differences preserved in the comparison.

capabilities.title: Import a bounded token proposal
capabilities.outcome: Validate a local token proposal against supported types, identifiers, units and reference limits before previewing any changes to the canonical collection or source.

capabilities.title: Export portable token metadata
capabilities.outcome: Export owned token definitions, modes, aliases and source references with an explicit format version and a report of unsupported target representations.

families.name: Borders backgrounds and surface effects
families.scope: Author supported border, radius, background and shadow declarations while preserving independent surface layers and their source ownership.
families.refusal: Refuse invalid layer syntax, unresolved asset ownership and changes that would silently replace unselected background layers or shared source rules.
families.recovery: Restore prior surface layers and declaration order through one journal transaction without resetting typography, layout or unrelated node content.
families.feedback: Show layer order, affected corners, source assets and clipping bounds with a preview of the exact declaration changes.
families.evidence: Use asymmetric borders, elliptical radii, multiple backgrounds, inset shadows, transparent surfaces and replaced media with independently checked geometry.

capabilities.title: Author independent border edges
capabilities.outcome: Set width, style and color for one border edge while preserving the remaining edges and any supported shorthand fallback declarations in source.

capabilities.title: Author logical border edges
capabilities.outcome: Edit block and inline border properties with a direction aware preview that identifies the corresponding physical edges for the selected element.

capabilities.title: Edit asymmetric corner radii
capabilities.outcome: Set individual corner radii independently and show their computed clipping shape without silently linking corners that the operator has not selected.

capabilities.title: Author elliptical corner radii
capabilities.outcome: Edit horizontal and vertical radius components for a supported corner and preview the browser's effective radius scaling when adjacent corners exceed available space.

capabilities.title: Inspect background layer ordering
capabilities.outcome: Display supported background layers in paint order and distinguish image, gradient and color contributions without collecting unrelated asset metadata or page text.

capabilities.title: Reorder owned background layers
capabilities.outcome: Preview a background layer reorder with all associated size, repeat, origin and clipping values moving with the intended layer as one transaction.

capabilities.title: Set background image positioning
capabilities.outcome: Edit one supported background layer's position through structured controls and show its reference box without changing the image or other layers.

capabilities.title: Set background image sizing
capabilities.outcome: Compare auto, cover, contain and supported explicit sizes for one background layer while exposing the resulting crop and preserved intrinsic aspect ratio.

capabilities.title: Author background repeat behavior
capabilities.outcome: Set repeat behavior independently on both axes and show the resulting tile boundaries without altering the selected layer's size, position or origin.

capabilities.title: Choose background origin and clipping
capabilities.outcome: Edit one layer's origin and clipping boxes and visualize the difference between the positioning area and the actual area receiving paint.

capabilities.title: Preview local background attachment
capabilities.outcome: Compare supported scroll, local and fixed background attachment behavior within the selected scroll context while showing platform dependent preview limitations.

capabilities.title: Create layered box shadows
capabilities.outcome: Add a supported box shadow layer with independent offsets, blur, spread and color while preserving the order and values of other shadows.

capabilities.title: Author inset surface shadows
capabilities.outcome: Preview inset shadow layers separately from outer shadows and show the padding edge and clipping behavior that determine their visible extent.

capabilities.title: Edit individual shadow layers
capabilities.outcome: Update one supported shadow layer and preview its effect without normalizing or rewriting the operator's other authored shadow expressions unnecessarily.

capabilities.title: Author text shadow layers
capabilities.outcome: Add or edit supported text shadows while preserving the actual text, semantic markup, decoration properties and other shadow layers on the selection.

capabilities.title: Inspect outline geometry separately
capabilities.outcome: Show outline width, style and offset independently from borders so operators can distinguish nonlayout outlines from dimensions that change the box model.

capabilities.title: Preview focus safe surface effects
capabilities.outcome: Compare a proposed surface effect with the existing focus indication and identify when clipping or contrast would obscure the focused control's visible boundary.

capabilities.title: Author object fit behavior
capabilities.outcome: Preview fill, contain, cover, none and scale down on supported replaced media while keeping its intrinsic content and explicit box dimensions separate.

capabilities.title: Author object positioning
capabilities.outcome: Move supported replaced media within its content box using object position and show the crop without altering the underlying asset or its stored dimensions.

capabilities.title: Compare reusable surface recipes
capabilities.outcome: Preview a versioned local surface recipe's border, radius, background and shadow changes against one owned target before applying the declared supported properties.

families.name: Transforms perspective and filters
families.scope: Inspect transform composition and author supported transform, perspective and filter declarations with explicit local preview and source ownership.
families.refusal: Refuse unsupported transform expressions, invalid filter resources and changes whose containing-block or stacking effects cannot be explained for the selected scope.
families.recovery: Undo the exact transform or filter transaction with prior operation order and unrelated layout declarations retained.
families.feedback: Show untransformed and transformed boxes, operation order, origins and any stacking or containing-block consequences before confirmation.
families.evidence: Use nested transforms, replaced images, perspective parents, long filter chains and keyboard focus targets without asserting identical GPU rendering across platforms.

capabilities.title: Inspect transform operation composition
capabilities.outcome: Display the authored transform operations in order and show the selected element's transformed box separately from its original layout box and dimensions.

capabilities.title: Author two dimensional translation
capabilities.outcome: Set supported horizontal and vertical translation values with explicit reference dimensions while preserving layout position, margins and the order of other transform operations.

capabilities.title: Author two dimensional scaling
capabilities.outcome: Preview independent horizontal and vertical scale factors and show their visual effect without silently changing the element's authored width, height or layout allocation.

capabilities.title: Author two dimensional rotation
capabilities.outcome: Set a supported rotation angle around the selected transform origin and display its resulting visual bounds independently from the unrotated layout box.

capabilities.title: Author supported skew transforms
capabilities.outcome: Edit skew angles with a live bounds preview and keep their operation order distinct from rotation, scaling and translation in the source expression.

capabilities.title: Edit transform origins
capabilities.outcome: Set supported transform origin coordinates and visualize the pivot point without rewriting the existing transform operations or unrelated object positioning declarations.

capabilities.title: Author individual transform properties
capabilities.outcome: Inspect and edit supported translate, rotate and scale properties with feedback explaining their composition relative to the authored transform property on the same element.

capabilities.title: Inspect nested transform coordinates
capabilities.outcome: Trace the selected element through transformed ancestors and distinguish local axes, parent axes and the final viewport coordinates used by selection overlays.

capabilities.title: Preview three dimensional translation
capabilities.outcome: Set a supported depth translation in a local preview and expose the perspective and parent transform context required for a visible depth effect.

capabilities.title: Preview three dimensional rotation
capabilities.outcome: Preview supported axis rotations with a visible orientation guide while distinguishing the element's projected appearance from changes to document or focus order.

capabilities.title: Author parent perspective depth
capabilities.outcome: Set a supported perspective distance on an owned parent and show which transformed descendants participate in that perspective context before persistence.

capabilities.title: Edit perspective origins
capabilities.outcome: Move the supported perspective origin with a local vanishing point guide and preserve the parent's depth value and unrelated descendant transform declarations.

capabilities.title: Inspect preserve three dimensional contexts
capabilities.outcome: Explain supported preserve three dimensional contexts and identify ancestor properties that flatten descendants rather than treating all nested transforms as one depth space.

capabilities.title: Configure backface visibility
capabilities.outcome: Preview visible or hidden backfaces on a supported transformed element and show the orientation at which the selected face stops contributing visible content.

capabilities.title: Inspect transform generated contexts
capabilities.outcome: Identify stacking or containing blocks introduced by a transform and preview any positioning consequences for selected fixed or absolutely positioned descendants.

capabilities.title: Author ordered image filter chains
capabilities.outcome: Edit supported brightness, contrast, saturation, grayscale and related filter operations while preserving operation order and the underlying media asset content.

capabilities.title: Author blur and drop shadow filters
capabilities.outcome: Preview supported blur and drop shadow filters with visible effect bounds and distinguish them from layout dimensions and independent box shadow declarations.

capabilities.title: Inspect backdrop filter boundaries
capabilities.outcome: Show the backdrop sampling and clipping context for supported backdrop filters, with an explicit limitation when the browser cannot provide a faithful local approximation.

capabilities.title: Compare transformed hit regions
capabilities.outcome: Compare visual transform bounds with actual pointer and keyboard target regions so an operator can identify interactions that become difficult to discover or activate.

capabilities.title: Export transform and filter metadata
capabilities.outcome: Export supported operation lists, origins and source references as inspectable design metadata without converting arbitrary computed matrices into claimed editable source expressions.

families.name: Interaction states and CSS transitions
families.scope: Preview explicit component states and author supported CSS transitions while separating temporary editor forcing from application interaction behavior.
families.refusal: Refuse unsupported state selectors, unsafe application event execution and transition changes without a resolvable owned rule and bounded property scope.
families.recovery: Restore prior state and transition declarations and clear forced preview states without retaining them in application data or production output.
families.feedback: Show the forced or genuine state, matching selector, animated property, duration and easing with keyboard reachable controls.
families.evidence: Use hover, focus, focus visible, checked, expanded and disabled controls with deterministic local timing fixtures and reduced motion previews.

capabilities.title: Force a local hover preview
capabilities.outcome: Temporarily preview a supported hover style in the editor and clearly label the forced state without changing actual application hover behavior or source markup.

capabilities.title: Force a local focus preview
capabilities.outcome: Preview supported focus styling without submitting forms or moving application focus to unavailable targets, and distinguish the forced style from genuine keyboard focus.

capabilities.title: Preview focus visible styling
capabilities.outcome: Compare focus and focus visible rules using explicit preview controls while preserving the browser's actual focus state and the application's keyboard interaction behavior.

capabilities.title: Preview active press styling
capabilities.outcome: Show a supported active press style as a temporary editor state and keep the simulation separate from a real pointer action or application command.

capabilities.title: Preview checked control styling
capabilities.outcome: Preview supported checked styles using a synthetic control state without updating the product's persisted form data or invoking a change handler in the real application.

capabilities.title: Preview expanded control styling
capabilities.outcome: Inspect supported expanded state selectors and show their style effect without opening a real provider backed action or modifying the application's saved navigation state.

capabilities.title: Preview selected item styling
capabilities.outcome: Compare supported selected and unselected visual rules on an owned component while retaining its semantic selection contract and clearly identifying temporary editor forcing.

capabilities.title: Preview disabled control styling
capabilities.outcome: Inspect native disabled and semantic disabled styling separately and explain that a visual preview does not establish the control's actual interaction or authorization behavior.

capabilities.title: Preview invalid input styling
capabilities.outcome: Show supported invalid and user invalid rules using synthetic local field fixtures while preventing actual submission, validation messages or persisted content from being altered.

capabilities.title: Compare combined pseudo states
capabilities.outcome: Preview supported combinations such as hover with focus and identify the exact winning declarations without assuming that each state rule applies independently.

capabilities.title: Author transition property lists
capabilities.outcome: Select explicit supported properties for a transition and show the consequences of broad all transitions before any authored transition property declaration is changed.

capabilities.title: Author transition durations
capabilities.outcome: Set supported transition durations with units and a local playback preview while keeping editor demonstration timing separate from the stored application value.

capabilities.title: Author transition delays
capabilities.outcome: Set supported transition delays and display when the selected property's change begins relative to the triggering state without modifying other transition entries.

capabilities.title: Choose standard transition easing
capabilities.outcome: Compare supported named easing functions on the same synthetic property change and store the operator's selected function without changing duration or delay values.

capabilities.title: Author cubic bezier easing
capabilities.outcome: Edit valid cubic bezier control points with constrained time coordinates and preview the resulting progression on a bounded deterministic local transition.

capabilities.title: Author step based easing
capabilities.outcome: Configure supported step easing functions with explicit step count and jump behavior so discontinuous changes can be previewed before they enter application source.

capabilities.title: Inspect transition interruption behavior
capabilities.outcome: Replay a supported state change interrupted midway and show how the browser continues from the current value rather than assuming a fresh transition from the initial state.

capabilities.title: Preview transitions with reduced motion
capabilities.outcome: Compare the active transition rules under default and reduced motion preferences and keep that preview preference separate from user accessibility settings or persisted source.

capabilities.title: Audit ineffective transition properties
capabilities.outcome: Identify transition entries whose properties do not change across the selected states or cannot animate as configured, with the matching rule and property shown.

capabilities.title: Capture a state transition comparison
capabilities.outcome: Capture a bounded local before, during and after comparison tied to the selected node, source revision and transition settings without presenting it as production interaction evidence.

families.name: Animation timelines and keyframes
families.scope: Author owned declarative animation timelines and supported keyframes after revisioned command and style ownership prerequisites are available.
families.refusal: Refuse executable animation code, unresolved target ownership, unbounded timelines and keyframe changes that cannot preserve supported source references.
families.recovery: Undo timeline transactions with keyframe ordering, target bindings and playback settings preserved; stop editor playback without leaving application state behind.
families.feedback: Show targets, duration, iteration policy, active keyframes, unsupported properties and reduced motion behavior before saving.
families.evidence: Use deterministic local clocks, interrupted playback, repeated targets, fractional offsets and preference variants with source and rendered state comparisons.

capabilities.title: Create an owned keyframe definition
capabilities.outcome: Create a named supported keyframe definition in an explicitly owned source location and keep it separate from animations belonging to imported or unsupported component code.

capabilities.title: Insert a keyframe at an offset
capabilities.outcome: Add a supported keyframe at a validated percentage offset and preserve the order, declarations and comments of the existing supported keyframe definition.

capabilities.title: Move a keyframe offset
capabilities.outcome: Preview an offset change with duplicate offset behavior explained and keep the affected property values unchanged unless the operator explicitly edits them.

capabilities.title: Edit keyframe property values
capabilities.outcome: Change a supported animatable property at one keyframe and show the resulting interpolation while preserving other properties and keyframes in the definition.

capabilities.title: Remove a supported keyframe
capabilities.outcome: Preview the interpolation changes caused by removing one keyframe and keep all remaining target bindings, offsets and declarations intact within the transaction.

capabilities.title: Bind an animation to an owned node
capabilities.outcome: Assign an existing supported keyframe definition to a selected owned node and show every source declaration needed without changing unrelated animation bindings.

capabilities.title: Author animation duration
capabilities.outcome: Set a bounded supported animation duration and compare playback against the previous value without persisting the editor's current playhead position into application source.

capabilities.title: Author animation delays
capabilities.outcome: Preview supported positive or negative delays with the effective starting point shown and preserve the definition's keyframes and target binding while saving the delay.

capabilities.title: Configure finite animation iterations
capabilities.outcome: Set an intentional finite iteration count with a local preview of the last cycle and the resulting retained or reverted visual state after playback.

capabilities.title: Configure continuous animation iterations
capabilities.outcome: Preview a supported continuous iteration policy with visible stop controls and reduced motion behavior before allowing the owned animation declaration to be saved.

capabilities.title: Choose animation playback direction
capabilities.outcome: Compare normal, reverse and alternate directions using the same keyframes while clearly showing the active cycle direction and preserving underlying document order.

capabilities.title: Choose animation fill behavior
capabilities.outcome: Compare none, forwards, backwards and both fill policies with explicit before and after states so retained styles are not mistaken for authored base declarations.

capabilities.title: Author keyframe easing segments
capabilities.outcome: Set supported easing for a keyframe segment and preview how it affects only the interval following that keyframe without rewriting the entire animation's timing policy.

capabilities.title: Compose multiple animation tracks
capabilities.outcome: Preview multiple supported animations on one target and expose property conflicts, composition rules and source order before the combined declaration is persisted.

capabilities.title: Scrub an isolated animation playhead
capabilities.outcome: Scrub an editor controlled timeline using a deterministic local clock while keeping playback state separate from product timers, saved records and provider interactions.

capabilities.title: Inspect animation property conflicts
capabilities.outcome: Identify properties animated by competing tracks and show the effective composition or replacement behavior together with the responsible definitions and target bindings.

capabilities.title: Preview animation interruption and restart
capabilities.outcome: Demonstrate interruption and restart behavior for a supported animation without invoking real application events or silently resetting the selected node's authored base style.

capabilities.title: Bind declarative animation start states
capabilities.outcome: Associate a supported local declarative state with an animation binding and preview its start behavior without introducing arbitrary executable callbacks into the source.

capabilities.title: Compare reduced motion animation variants
capabilities.outcome: Preview explicitly authored reduced motion variants against the default timeline and reveal missing alternatives without claiming that a short duration alone solves every motion concern.

capabilities.title: Export animation timeline metadata
capabilities.outcome: Export supported keyframes, timings, target identifiers and source references with an explicit format version and an inventory of expressions that remain unsupported or read only.

families.name: Scroll driven visual behavior
families.scope: Inspect scroll ownership and author supported declarative scroll interactions using bounded local previews that preserve native navigation and focus.
families.refusal: Refuse arbitrary scroll event code, unsupported timeline syntax and effects that require provider state or silently lock keyboard users into a scroll region.
families.recovery: Restore prior scroll interaction declarations and clear preview offsets without altering saved routes, product data or the operator’s browser history.
families.feedback: Show the owning scroller, progress range, target visibility, active effect and reduced motion alternatives with explicit preview controls.
families.evidence: Use nested scrollers, sticky headers, short content, horizontal layouts, keyboard scrolling and reduced motion fixtures at deterministic local offsets.

capabilities.title: Inspect scroll progress for a target
capabilities.outcome: Display the selected element's position within its owning scroll container and distinguish document scroll progress from the visibility progress of the target itself.

capabilities.title: Preview a document scroll timeline
capabilities.outcome: Preview a supported declarative document scroll timeline with a visible progress readout and a bounded set of owned animation targets before persistence.

capabilities.title: Preview an element scroll timeline
capabilities.outcome: Associate a supported timeline with an explicitly chosen scroll container and show why other ancestor scrollers do not determine that timeline's progress.

capabilities.title: Author named scroll timelines
capabilities.outcome: Create or rename a supported named scroll timeline with a reference preview that identifies every owned animation binding affected by the proposed change.

capabilities.title: Author view progress timelines
capabilities.outcome: Preview a supported view timeline for one target and show the intervals during which the element enters, occupies and leaves the selected scrollport.

capabilities.title: Set timeline attachment ranges
capabilities.outcome: Edit supported start and end attachment ranges and visualize their positions relative to the scroller and target rather than presenting them as generic percentages.

capabilities.title: Choose timeline scroll axes
capabilities.outcome: Select a supported block, inline, horizontal or vertical timeline axis and expose how writing mode changes the direction used for progress calculation.

capabilities.title: Preview supported parallax offsets
capabilities.outcome: Demonstrate bounded transform offsets tied to scroll progress while preserving normal document flow, native scrolling and a visible reduced motion alternative.

capabilities.title: Preview sticky section transitions
capabilities.outcome: Compare sticky section positioning with supported progress driven visual changes and identify the actual scroller and containment limits that govern the combined result.

capabilities.title: Author scroll snap alignment
capabilities.outcome: Set supported snap alignment for one target and show its alignment area together with existing scroll margin and container padding contributions.

capabilities.title: Author scroll snap container policy
capabilities.outcome: Configure a supported snapping axis and strictness on the owning container with a preview that preserves keyboard reachability of content between snap positions.

capabilities.title: Preview scroll snap stop behavior
capabilities.outcome: Compare normal and always stop policies on selected owned targets while clearly separating the local browser demonstration from cross platform input device behavior.

capabilities.title: Inspect unreachable scroll effects
capabilities.outcome: Report supported timelines that cannot progress because content does not overflow or a target never crosses the required range in the current fixture.

capabilities.title: Compare nested scroll interaction progress
capabilities.outcome: Show separate progress indicators for nested scrollers and identify which one drives each owned effect without merging unrelated scroll offsets or target identities.

capabilities.title: Preview anchor navigation offsets
capabilities.outcome: Preview an existing local anchor jump against sticky content and supported scroll margins while leaving real browser history and persisted route state unchanged.

capabilities.title: Author smooth scroll preference behavior
capabilities.outcome: Preview supported smooth scrolling separately from instant behavior and expose an intentional reduced motion policy without changing the operator's actual system preferences.

capabilities.title: Inspect scroll linked focus visibility
capabilities.outcome: Trace whether a focused target stays visibly reachable during a supported scroll effect and identify clipping, transforms or sticky layers responsible for its obstruction.

capabilities.title: Simulate short viewport scroll behavior
capabilities.outcome: Run a bounded local scroll comparison in short viewports and reveal effects whose progress or content accessibility depends on unavailable vertical space.

capabilities.title: Compare reduced motion scroll effects
capabilities.outcome: Compare the default scroll driven effect with an explicitly authored reduced motion variant while preserving the same content, scroll range and semantic document order.

capabilities.title: Capture scroll interaction checkpoints
