capabilities.outcome: Capture selected deterministic scroll positions with target identifiers, active conditions and source revisions so the supported effect can be reviewed without publishing a live page.

families.name: Form layout and visual state design
families.scope: Design owned form layouts and supported control styles using synthetic preview values while preserving real submission, validation and data handling boundaries.
families.refusal: Refuse provider submissions, credentials, real personal data and arbitrary event handlers; unsupported source controls remain inspectable with no persistence claim.
families.recovery: Restore form design transactions without overwriting application values, validation state, submitted data or unrelated component behavior.
families.feedback: Show label relationships, state origin, synthetic preview status, layout effects and supported source changes before confirmation.
families.evidence: Use synthetic text fields, radios, checkboxes, select controls, validation summaries and keyboard navigation without sending any form or provider request.

capabilities.title: Design labeled text field layouts
capabilities.outcome: Preview supported label and input arrangements with synthetic values and preserve the real control's identity, data binding and submission behavior during source scoped layout edits.

capabilities.title: Design stacked field spacing
capabilities.outcome: Edit supported spacing between form fields with error and help text present so the resulting layout does not assume every field occupies the same height.

capabilities.title: Design responsive field columns
capabilities.outcome: Preview owned field groups in supported responsive columns while preserving the DOM and keyboard order of all controls at each selected width.

capabilities.title: Inspect explicit label associations
capabilities.outcome: Show which supported label identifies each form control and reveal missing, repeated or unresolved references without collecting the control's current value or submitted data.

capabilities.title: Inspect help text associations
capabilities.outcome: Show supported descriptive text relationships for a selected control and distinguish visible help text from the accessible description supplied through explicit references.

capabilities.title: Design required field indicators
capabilities.outcome: Preview required indicators with visible explanatory text and ensure the design does not rely only on a color or silently change the control's validation contract.

capabilities.title: Design inline validation presentation
capabilities.outcome: Preview a synthetic field error beside its control and show how the error text changes layout without invoking real validation or replacing the application's error handling.

capabilities.title: Design form error summaries
capabilities.outcome: Preview a synthetic error summary with supported control references and verify its layout and focus destinations without submitting the form or altering saved validation state.

capabilities.title: Design checkbox control groups
capabilities.outcome: Preview owned checkbox groups with supported labels, descriptions and mixed visual states while leaving the application's real selections and change handlers untouched.

capabilities.title: Design radio control groups
capabilities.outcome: Preview supported radio group arrangements with synthetic selections and preserve the grouping and keyboard contract instead of replacing native behavior with decorative boxes.

capabilities.title: Design select control sizing
capabilities.outcome: Preview supported native select dimensions with long synthetic option labels and disclose browser specific popup appearance that the local style editor cannot author reliably.

capabilities.title: Design multiline text input layouts
capabilities.outcome: Preview supported textarea sizing, resizing and wrapping with synthetic long content while preserving its actual value, selection and application input event handling.

capabilities.title: Design input prefix and suffix regions
capabilities.outcome: Preview owned prefix, suffix and action regions with explicit control relationships and ensure decorative additions do not obscure the actual editable or focusable area.

capabilities.title: Design file input presentation
capabilities.outcome: Preview supported file input layout and labels using synthetic empty or selected states without opening a file picker, uploading content or reading local file paths.

capabilities.title: Design form action group spacing
capabilities.outcome: Preview primary, secondary and destructive form actions with long labels and narrow widths while preserving their explicit button types and original activation behavior.

capabilities.title: Preview form autofill styling
capabilities.outcome: Inspect supported autofill style rules with an explicitly simulated local appearance and avoid reading browser saved credentials or changing the user's autofill configuration.

capabilities.title: Preview read only form controls
capabilities.outcome: Compare read only and disabled visual treatments with synthetic controls and explain the distinct interaction and submission semantics without changing real application permissions.

capabilities.title: Preview pending submission presentation
capabilities.outcome: Preview a synthetic pending state with visible progress text and preserved focus so busy styling does not imply that a provider request has been sent.

capabilities.title: Preview successful form feedback
capabilities.outcome: Preview a synthetic success state with clear text and layout retention while leaving actual submission receipts, provider responses and persisted application records unchanged.

capabilities.title: Audit form layout under text expansion
capabilities.outcome: Compare owned form layouts with longer synthetic labels, help and error text to identify clipped controls or broken associations without exposing real user field values.

families.name: Canvas navigation and comparison workspaces
families.scope: Extend the existing center canvas and compact rails with bounded navigation and synchronized comparison controls without replacing the familiar editor shell.
families.refusal: Refuse stale targets, inaccessible cross origin frame content and comparison requests beyond declared resource budgets; retain the current selected route and source scope.
families.recovery: Restore the previous canvas view and selection after closing a comparison without changing application data, persistent forms or source content.
families.feedback: Show active view scale, viewport dimensions, selected route, synchronization status and any preview inspection limits in visible controls.
families.evidence: Use deeply nested targets, multiple local widths, dock changes, keyboard navigation, large pages and iframe reloads with protected source and model fingerprints.

capabilities.title: Zoom the editor canvas independently
capabilities.outcome: Change the editor's visual zoom while retaining the actual preview viewport dimensions and clearly distinguishing canvas magnification from browser text scale or application breakpoints.

capabilities.title: Pan a magnified canvas view
capabilities.outcome: Move around an oversized preview with explicit pointer and keyboard controls while preserving application scroll offsets and the selected element's stable inspection target.

capabilities.title: Fit a selected element in view
capabilities.outcome: Fit the available rendered bounds of the selected element within the canvas without changing application dimensions, making hidden content visible or rewriting source styles.

capabilities.title: Fit a selected page region
capabilities.outcome: Fit a bounded owned page region in the canvas and preserve the current viewport configuration, selected route and document scroll relationship shown by the editor.

capabilities.title: Show page coordinate rulers
capabilities.outcome: Display local page coordinate rulers that account for canvas zoom and scrolling while keeping their overlays isolated from the application DOM and production assets.

capabilities.title: Show configurable alignment guides
capabilities.outcome: Display temporary editor alignment guides in page coordinates and distinguish them from authored application grid, margin or layout declarations.

capabilities.title: Snap editor measurements to guides
capabilities.outcome: Snap a measurement overlay to explicitly configured editor guides without moving document nodes or claiming that a visual measurement operation has authored layout changes.

capabilities.title: Measure distances between rendered boxes
capabilities.outcome: Measure spacing between two current rendered elements with their border and content boxes identified, refusing stale or unavailable targets rather than guessing missing dimensions.

capabilities.title: Measure a selected rendered region
capabilities.outcome: Create a temporary rectangular canvas measurement with page coordinate dimensions and clear dismissal controls without inserting elements or styles into application source.

capabilities.title: Compare synchronized viewport previews
capabilities.outcome: Open a bounded set of local viewports for one route and preserve corresponding source selection while reporting unavailable elements independently for each rendered preview.

capabilities.title: Synchronize preview scroll by target
capabilities.outcome: Align comparison previews using the same current target or section identity and report missing targets instead of forcing identical raw pixel offsets across different layouts.

capabilities.title: Synchronize inspected source across previews
capabilities.outcome: Select the supported source identity in each comparison preview and distinguish exact, missing and ambiguous matches without selecting a similarly labeled unrelated element.

capabilities.title: Compare two local routes side by side
capabilities.outcome: Show two explicitly selected local routes within a bounded comparison workspace while retaining separate route, viewport and selection context for each preview pane.

capabilities.title: Compare a saved local visual baseline
capabilities.outcome: Compare the current rendered view against an explicitly chosen local baseline image with its source and viewport metadata visible and no claim of live production equivalence.

capabilities.title: Overlay rendered box differences
capabilities.outcome: Overlay bounded position and size differences for matched current elements between two previews and identify missing or unmatched targets without silently discarding them.

capabilities.title: Bookmark a local canvas inspection
capabilities.outcome: Save a nonsecret editor bookmark for route, viewport and supported source identity, excluding application input values, private rendered text and provider session credentials.

capabilities.title: Restore a canvas inspection bookmark
capabilities.outcome: Restore an explicit local bookmark and report unresolved routes or targets without activating stale DOM references or overwriting the current application's persisted records.

capabilities.title: Keep selection visible during dock changes
capabilities.outcome: Reposition only editor viewport framing when a dock changes size so the selected available element stays discoverable without altering the application's layout or authored dimensions.

capabilities.title: Navigate editor inspections backward
capabilities.outcome: Move through bounded editor selection history separately from product browser history and refuse stale document targets without triggering application navigation or source mutations.

capabilities.title: Export bounded canvas measurement notes
capabilities.outcome: Export selected nonsecret measurement geometry, route and source references with viewport and zoom context while excluding rendered content, form values and local filesystem paths.

families.name: Semantic accessibility inspection and authoring
families.scope: Inspect supported semantic relationships and author explicit owned markup corrections through canonical document and source command boundaries.
families.refusal: Refuse speculative role substitutions, unresolved accessible name references, private input reads and source edits that cannot preserve native interaction contracts.
families.recovery: Restore semantic declaration transactions without losing labels, node identities, supported references or the application’s original event behavior.
families.feedback: Show computed role, name sources, description references and native versus explicit semantics; identify the limits of browser derived inspection.
families.evidence: Use synthetic headings, landmarks, links, buttons, composite controls, hidden references and multilingual labels with local keyboard and accessibility tree observations.

capabilities.title: Inspect computed semantic roles
capabilities.outcome: Display the browser exposed role for the selected element alongside its native element type and explicit role attribute without implying equivalent interaction behavior between them.

capabilities.title: Trace accessible name sources
capabilities.outcome: Show supported label, referenced text and fallback name sources for a selected control while avoiding input values and clearly marking unresolved browser specific computations.

capabilities.title: Trace accessible descriptions
capabilities.outcome: Inspect supported description references and distinguish them from the control's accessible name and visible help text without aggregating unrelated private container content.

capabilities.title: Inspect heading hierarchy
capabilities.outcome: Display the current rendered heading structure with levels, source references and skipped transitions while making the inspected route and hidden content scope explicit.

capabilities.title: Author owned heading levels
capabilities.outcome: Preview a supported semantic heading level change separately from visual font size and preserve the selected heading's identity, text and source mapping in the transaction.

capabilities.title: Inspect landmark regions
capabilities.outcome: Show supported landmark regions with names and nesting so operators can identify missing or duplicated navigation context without rewriting application structure automatically.

capabilities.title: Author named landmark regions
capabilities.outcome: Add or edit a supported landmark's explicit accessible name through an owned source mapping without changing its descendants, visual styling or unrelated region labels.

capabilities.title: Inspect image alternative text ownership
capabilities.outcome: Show whether a supported image has authored alternative text, an explicit decorative designation or an unresolved source mapping without inventing a replacement description.

capabilities.title: Author image alternative text proposals
capabilities.outcome: Preview an operator supplied bounded alternative text change with its owned source diff and preserve the original media asset, captions and other image attributes.

capabilities.title: Inspect decorative media semantics
capabilities.outcome: Show supported decorative image and icon semantics and explain their effect on accessibility exposure without hiding interactive descendants or changing visible content automatically.

capabilities.title: Inspect link purpose and destination
capabilities.outcome: Display a selected link's supported accessible label and local destination metadata without following external links, submitting credentials or treating destination text as an authorization grant.

capabilities.title: Inspect button element semantics
capabilities.outcome: Identify whether an apparent button uses a native button or an authored substitute and expose its declared type and supported interaction contract before offering corrections.

capabilities.title: Inspect form group semantics
capabilities.outcome: Show supported fieldset, legend and group label relationships using synthetic fixtures and identify unresolved references without reading or exporting actual form values.

capabilities.title: Inspect expanded control relationships
capabilities.outcome: Trace supported expanded state and controlled region references while distinguishing declared semantics from verified application behavior or actual visibility of the controlled content.

capabilities.title: Inspect tab and panel relationships
capabilities.outcome: Display supported tab, tablist and panel associations with selected state references and identify inconsistent identifiers without simulating unsupported keyboard interaction automatically.

capabilities.title: Inspect dialog naming and modality
capabilities.outcome: Show supported dialog name, description and modality declarations and distinguish them from actual focus containment or browser top layer behavior that needs runtime verification.

capabilities.title: Inspect live region declarations
capabilities.outcome: Display supported live region roles and politeness settings, preserving bounded fixture text and clearly separating declaration inspection from actual assistive technology announcements.

capabilities.title: Author explicit language metadata
capabilities.outcome: Preview a supported language or direction declaration for an owned node and show its inherited context without translating content or altering unrelated locale records.

capabilities.title: Inspect hidden accessibility relationships
capabilities.outcome: Explain supported hidden, inert and semantic hidden ancestry separately and identify referenced labels that remain valid without changing app visibility or focus behavior.

capabilities.title: Export a bounded semantic inventory
capabilities.outcome: Export inspected roles, source identities and supported relationship identifiers with scope limitations while excluding private field values and avoiding any accessibility certification claim.

families.name: Focus readability and reduced motion design
families.scope: Preview and inspect perceptual accessibility behavior using explicit local preferences and synthetic interaction fixtures within the existing editor shell.
families.refusal: Refuse silent changes to operating system preferences, destructive page actions and findings that require private user text, credentials or unsupported assistive technology assumptions.
families.recovery: Clear local preference simulations and restore prior editor focus and visual state without modifying application records or the user’s saved accessibility preferences.
families.feedback: Show the active simulation, measured geometry, observed focus target and inspection limitations using text and shape as well as color.
families.evidence: Use text zoom, narrow viewports, forced color previews, obscured focus, reduced motion and keyboard traversal with deterministic synthetic controls.

capabilities.title: Inspect visible keyboard focus regions
capabilities.outcome: Display the focused control's actual rendered focus region and identify clipping or covering layers while retaining the real keyboard navigation sequence in the local fixture.

capabilities.title: Preview owned focus indicator styles
capabilities.outcome: Preview a supported focus indicator declaration on an owned control with clear comparison to its previous appearance and no silent suppression of native outlines.

capabilities.title: Measure focus indicator separation
capabilities.outcome: Measure a supported focus indicator against adjacent control boundaries and backgrounds with explicit geometry assumptions rather than presenting a complete compliance certification.

capabilities.title: Inspect focus obscured by sticky content
capabilities.outcome: Identify when a focused target is covered by sticky or fixed content in the local preview and reveal the responsible layer and scroll position.

capabilities.title: Preview focus restoration after dismissal
capabilities.outcome: Use a synthetic owned overlay flow to compare its explicit opener and restored focus target without changing real application dialogs or persisting product interaction state.

capabilities.title: Inspect visual and focus order differences
capabilities.outcome: Compare current rendered position order with actual keyboard traversal for supported controls and identify layout declarations causing visible sequence differences without reordering source automatically.

capabilities.title: Measure interactive target geometry
capabilities.outcome: Show the rendered activation area and neighboring target distances for supported controls, separating actual event targets from decorative icons or visually enlarged backgrounds.

capabilities.title: Preview touch sized control spacing
capabilities.outcome: Preview an operator selected target size and spacing policy on owned controls while preserving their source identity, labels and actual activation behavior in the fixture.

capabilities.title: Preview text scale without layout zoom
capabilities.outcome: Apply a temporary local text scale simulation and distinguish changes in font metrics from canvas zoom or authored responsive dimensions while preserving saved user preferences.

capabilities.title: Inspect text scale overflow
capabilities.outcome: Identify clipped or overlapping supported text after a local scale simulation and trace the responsible sizing, overflow or line height declarations without reading private form values.

capabilities.title: Preview narrow layout reflow
capabilities.outcome: Compare the same synthetic content at constrained widths and identify regions that require unintended two dimensional scrolling while preserving the selected reading and keyboard order.

capabilities.title: Inspect extended line spacing effects
capabilities.outcome: Preview a declared local line spacing simulation and report clipping or overlapping content caused by fixed heights without modifying actual application accessibility settings.

capabilities.title: Inspect expanded character spacing effects
capabilities.outcome: Preview supported character spacing adjustments on synthetic content and identify truncation or control clipping with the responsible style and source references visible.

capabilities.title: Preview reduced motion preferences
capabilities.outcome: Switch only the local preview's reduced motion simulation and show which supported media conditions become active without changing system settings or assuming all motion has stopped.

capabilities.title: Inventory persistent visual motion
capabilities.outcome: List supported declared animations that continue without interaction and expose their timing and source while distinguishing source declarations from a complete observation of runtime motion.

capabilities.title: Preview animation pause controls
capabilities.outcome: Use synthetic motion fixtures to inspect an owned pause control's label, state and focus behavior without pausing unrelated application processes or altering provider interactions.

capabilities.title: Inspect flashing visual patterns locally
capabilities.outcome: Analyze a bounded local animation fixture using an explicit measurement method and report uncertainty instead of presenting a complete medical or accessibility safety conclusion.

capabilities.title: Preview high contrast design variants
capabilities.outcome: Compare explicitly authored contrast preference variants with the same synthetic controls and content, keeping them separate from the operating system's actual contrast settings.

capabilities.title: Inspect color independent state feedback
capabilities.outcome: Check selected synthetic component states for visible text or shape differences in addition to color and report missing cues without changing actual product status records.

capabilities.title: Export perceptual inspection observations
capabilities.outcome: Export bounded measurements, active simulations and source references with observed viewport conditions and limitations, excluding private content and any claim of assistive technology certification.

families.name: Design review and visual quality evidence
families.scope: Produce bounded local design review observations tied to source, viewport and fixture identity; distinguish proposed improvements from accepted runtime behavior.
families.refusal: Refuse unsupported baseline matches, missing source revisions, hidden private content capture and any attempt to turn local review into publication or universal quality certification.
families.recovery: Retain original baselines and observations when a comparison fails; restore editor selection and remove temporary review overlays after dismissal.
families.feedback: Show measured differences, capture conditions, source revisions and unresolved matches with explicit pending, passed or failed observation scope.
families.evidence: Use deterministic local routes and synthetic data to verify source fingerprints, geometry comparisons, baseline immutability and honest incomplete review summaries.

capabilities.title: Create scoped visual review runs
capabilities.outcome: Create a local review record with explicitly selected routes, widths, fixture identifiers and source revision before capturing observations or evaluating any declared visual policy.

capabilities.title: Capture deterministic route screenshots
capabilities.outcome: Capture selected local routes after explicit readiness conditions with stable fixture data, viewport and rendering settings recorded alongside each image and source revision.

capabilities.title: Compare screenshots with aligned baselines
capabilities.outcome: Compare a current local capture against an explicitly matched baseline with identical declared conditions and report mismatches in route, viewport or fixture identity before computing differences.

capabilities.title: Inspect geometry regression summaries
capabilities.outcome: Summarize bounded element position and size changes using supported stable identities and expose missing, ambiguous or newly added elements separately from matched geometry differences.

capabilities.title: Review spacing rhythm consistency
capabilities.outcome: Compare selected owned elements against an explicit local spacing policy and show the source declarations behind deviations without silently normalizing authored design choices.

capabilities.title: Review typography hierarchy consistency
capabilities.outcome: Compare selected text style roles against a declared local typography policy using metadata and synthetic specimens rather than collecting private rendered application text.

capabilities.title: Review component state completeness
capabilities.outcome: List explicitly declared visual states missing from a supported component's local review fixtures and keep absence of a fixture separate from proof that the state is broken.

capabilities.title: Review breakpoint coverage gaps
capabilities.outcome: Compare declared responsive conditions with the widths included in a local review run and identify unobserved intervals or exact boundaries without inventing passing results.

capabilities.title: Review content expansion resilience
capabilities.outcome: Run synthetic long text and label variants through selected owned components and record clipped, overlapping or unavailable regions with their source references and capture conditions.

capabilities.title: Review empty content layout states
capabilities.outcome: Preview explicitly supported empty content fixtures and capture missing structure or confusing feedback without deleting actual application records or treating the fixture as a production state.

capabilities.title: Review loading layout stability
capabilities.outcome: Compare explicitly held synthetic loading and ready fixtures for selected components and record geometry changes with source and timing conditions instead of claiming live performance metrics.

capabilities.title: Review error state layout resilience
capabilities.outcome: Capture declared local failure fixtures with synthetic messages and identify clipped controls, missing actions or disrupted reading order without causing real provider failures or submissions.

capabilities.title: Review long page orientation cues
capabilities.outcome: Inspect selected long local routes for bounded heading, navigation and selected element context so an operator can locate review findings without losing the original canvas target.

capabilities.title: Review hidden overflow findings
capabilities.outcome: Collect bounded findings for unavailable or clipped rendered regions and identify responsible ancestors while keeping hidden content private and avoiding automatic visibility changes.

capabilities.title: Review visual asset fit policies
capabilities.outcome: Compare supported media elements against an explicit local fit and crop policy and show mismatches without uploading assets, modifying original files or assuming a universal preferred crop.

capabilities.title: Attach source linked design observations
capabilities.outcome: Attach a bounded local observation to a supported source identity and revision with plain text evidence while excluding credentials, private field values and invented acceptance status.

capabilities.title: Resolve visual observation lifecycle
capabilities.outcome: Track an observation as pending, addressed or verified with explicit evidence references and retain its original source basis rather than accepting a design change from a label alone.

capabilities.title: Compare design review run revisions
capabilities.outcome: Compare two local review runs with their original capture conditions and expose changed, unresolved or incomparable observations without overwriting the earlier run's retained evidence.

capabilities.title: Export a bounded design review package
capabilities.outcome: Export selected nonsecret review metadata, captures and source fingerprints with a manifest while retaining the declared local scope and excluding runtime credentials or provider authority.

capabilities.title: Validate design review evidence integrity
capabilities.outcome: Verify the referenced source and artifact fingerprints before presenting a review summary and report missing or altered evidence without repairing, deleting or relabeling original observations.
